digest/state#

An immutable digest of an ordered byte history.

Version: v1.0.0

Synopsis#

let complete = partial.state([byte(0), byte(255)]);
complete.bytes(); // partial is still available for another branch

Description#

An immutable digest of an ordered byte history. bytes() returns raw bytes and hex() the same as lowercase hex; the algorithms also take text as UTF-8. state(bytes) appends into a fresh successor without changing this digest, its earlier bytes() results or the input. Empty chunks preserve the result. Observation does not prevent later append. Empty concrete constructors bind empty input; digest computation is deferred until bytes() is observed.

No I/O, resource ownership or close action. Algorithm-specific output widths, errors and security limitations belong to concrete modules. The test-only fake echoes bytes; it is not a cryptographic function or an algorithm oracle.

Public API#

role Digesting#

role Digesting

A digest fed bytes piece by piece; each state is a value, so a prefix can be shared.
